description: Smart-Grid Smart-City Customer Trial Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Government Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. This data is from the customer trial conducted as part of the Smart Grid Smart City (SGSC) project (2010-2014). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Government Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water. Its tags are Electricity, Utilities and Communication, appliance, campaign, control. It offers 8 resource(s) in .CSV, 7ZIP, CSV, EXCEL (.XLSX). The portal shows 2022-04-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
